test_title: PYST 44 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:

Had the meticulous investigators examined all the critical evidence before they closed the case?

options.text: Was all the critical evidence examined by the meticulous investigators before they closed the case?
Had all the critical evidence been examined by the meticulous investigators before they closed the case?
Has all the critical evidence been examined by the meticulous investigators before they closed the case?
Had all the critical evidence examined by the meticulous investigators before they closed the case?

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Had all the critical evidence been examined by the meticulous investigators before they closed the case? .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To transform a sentence into **passive voice**, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The correct structure for passive voice transformation of a past perfect sentence is **Had + object + been + past participle + by + subject.**
 
• In the given sentence, the original subject is "the meticulous investigators," the object is "all the critical evidence," and the verb is "had examined."
 
• After transformation, the sentence reads: **Had all the critical evidence been examined by the meticulous investigators before they closed the case?**

Correct sentence: *Had all the critical evidence been examined by the meticulous investigators before they closed the case?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active Voice:** The subject performs the action described by the verb.
 
 
• **Example:** The meticulous investigators examined all the critical evidence.
 
 
 
• **Passive Voice:** The object of the active sentence becomes the subject, and the verb is modified accordingly.
 
 
• **Example:** All the critical evidence was examined by the meticulous investigators.
